gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-kufam: Outrun Future draws every letter with one steady pen-width outline, spaced wide apart. Kufam's curves open generously and its line keeps one tube-like width, echoing that neon-sign consistency in quieter form.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-liter: Synthwave swagger, drawn in a wide-spaced outline: Outrun Future leads with authority. Liter follows with zero stroke contrast, lowercase of great height and wide-mouthed rounds that give the heading room to shout.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-mada: Outrun Future looks drawn with a single pen tip, wide and spaced. Mada's towering midzone and curves that refuse to close give that pen-tip outline an approachable, open-handed partner below.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-martel-sans: Neon-era attitude: Outrun Future builds its bowls at the exact thickness of its stems, spaced far apart. Martel Sans keeps every curve generously open and its mean line high.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-matangi: Matangi's strokes look like twine pressed flat, its rounded letters left fully open. Outrun Future does wide-set, outlined synthwave authority best, while Matangi's hefty lowercase handles the everyday talking.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-maven-pro: Maven Pro brings a gentle monotone line, a high-waisted lowercase and a welcoming gap in the letter c. Outrun Future supplies the wide-set, outlined synthwave punch above, no competition.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-miriam-libre: Miriam Libre draws like wire, with an s that opens generously. Outrun Future is best at wide-spaced, outlined authority, while Miriam Libre's cast-iron-tall lowercase does the quieter work of carrying words.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-mozilla-head: Outrun Future keeps its curves full at the shoulders, with wide spacing and an outline of constant width. Mozilla Headline then reads big-bodied and friendly, its splayed c terminals keeping paragraphs easygoing.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-mozilla-text: Authoritative and synthwave, Outrun Future holds a constant pen pressure steadily through wide-set letters and short ascenders. Mozilla Text then runs on bold-looking, its flared terminals keeping paragraphs moving.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-noto-kufi-ar: Outrun Future's crossbars are as fat as the stems they join. That makes it best at loud, wide-set statements, while Noto Kufi Arabic is best at modest, open-curved lines where capitals barely rise above lowercase.
